text:
Maya: Quick thread to lock down PM follow-ups after last week's DB outage. We need owners, clear due dates, and a tiny tracker.

Jose: Agreed. Replica lag showed up again. I will export open actions and map owners today.

Riley: Suggested minimal timeline template: Action | Owner | Due | Verify | Recurrence | Pattern. Example row:
- Rotate replica config | @Anita | 2025-11-06 | smoke test + 24h monitor | quarterly | replication

Anita: Taking replica rotation. Ill add a runbook link and exact verify commands. Target 2025-11-06. :white_check_mark:

Tom: IC handoff was fuzzy during the incident. Proposing 2-week IC terms, explicit Slack handoff format, and a pinned one-line checklist. Handoff template: `IC HANDOFF: from @old to @new | status: <short> | blockers: <list>`

Lina: I can own drafting the IC rotation rules + handoff template and a comms cadence doc. Recommend: initial ack <=5m, owner assigned <=15m, hourly updates for major incidents, final PM stub within 48h. Also weekly 10-min follow-up for open actions.

Maya: Tracking plan: one Sheet with columns action, owner, created_ts, due_ts, status, verify_notes, recurrence_flag, incident_pattern. Jose will post link. Reminders + weekly digest.

incident-bot: Reminder: 3 open postmortem actions assigned. Reply `ack` to snooze.

Maya: Actions from thread:
- Jose: consolidate open actions into tracker by EOD (due 2025-10-31)
- Anita: rotate replica config + post runbook (due 2025-11-06)
- Lina: draft IC rotation + handoff + comms cadence (due 2025-11-03)
- Riley: add timeline template & incident pattern column to sheet (due 2025-11-01)

Jose: Acknowledged. I'll DM owners for acceptance and post the sheet link here.

Maya: We'll review the tracker in next Tuesday's 10-min slot. Update the sheet if owners or dates change. :thumbsup:
